excerpt: We consider neutrinos produced in the early universe; solar neutrinos; geoneutrinos; supernova neutrinos, including the diffuse supernova neutrino background (DSNB); neutrinos produced in the atmosphere; and high-energy astrophysical neutrinos.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); Y. Koshio, G. D. Orebi Gann, E. O’Sullivan, I. Tamborra
title: Snowmass 2021 topical group report: Neutrinos from Natural Sources
